investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous DNS traffic reported from srv-prod-infra-01 (192.168.153.249) to internal DNS server 172.16.40.3 with high-entropy subdomain queries for sharepoint.com; total tunneled bytes higher than typical (313 vs 50). The subdomains include production SharePoint/Office365 endpoints and edge/msedge related domains, which are consistent with legitimate enterprise services rather than a singular exfiltration channel. Given the root domain is a well-known service with established identity and the query patterns align with CDN/edge service traffic, this alert is classified as Low Priority; no immediate containment actions seem warranted, though continued monitoring and correlation with user activity or other DNS anomalies is recommended.
